import sys

def read():
    v = 0
    f = 1
    c = sys.stdin.read(1)
    while c < '0' or c > '9':
        if c == '-':
            f = -1
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
    while '0' <= c <= '9':
        v = v * 10 + ord(c) - ord('0')
        c = sys.stdin.read(1)
    return v * f

def mod_pow(x, p, mod):
    ret = 1
    while p:
        if p & 1:
            ret = ret * x % mod
        x = x * x % mod
        p >>= 1
    return ret

def mod_inv(x, mod):
    return mod_pow(x, mod - 2, mod)

def add(x, y, mod):
    x += y
    if x >= mod:
        x -= mod
    return x

def sub(x, y, mod):
    x -= y
    if x < 0:
        x += mod
    return x

def FWT(P, opt, mod):
    N = 1048576
    for i in range(2, N + 1, i << 1):
        p = i >> 1
        for j in range(0, N, i):
            for k in range(j, j + p):
                if opt == 1:
                    P[k] = add(P[k], P[k + p], mod)
                else:
                    P[k] = sub(P[k], P[k + p], mod)

def main():
    mod = 10**9 + 7
    n = read()
    p = [[0] * 10 for _ in range(10)]
    
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            val = read()
            p[i][j] = val * mod_inv(100, mod) % mod
    
    if n < 6:
        for i in range(n, 6):
            p[i][i] = 1
        n = 6
    
    A = (1 << 6) - 1
    id_map = [0] * 64
    ki = 0
    for i in range(64):
        if bin(i).count('1') == 3:
            id_map[i] = ki
            ki += 1
    
    X = [0] * (1 << 18)
    Y = [0] * (1 << 18)
    
    # First part for X
    for i in range(1 << 18):
        msk1 = i & A
        msk2 = (i >> 6) & A
        msk3 = (i >> 12) & A
        
        mask = 0
        pp = 1
        
        for j in range(6):
            if (msk1 >> j) & 1:
                pp = pp * p[0][j] % mod
            else:
                pp = pp * (mod + 1 - p[0][j]) % mod
        
        for j in range(6):
            if (msk2 >> j) & 1:
                pp = pp * p[1][j] % mod
            else:
                pp = pp * (mod + 1 - p[1][j]) % mod
        
        for j in range(6):
            if (msk3 >> j) & 1:
                pp = pp * p[2][j] % mod
            else:
                pp = pp * (mod + 1 - p[2][j]) % mod
        
        if pp == 0:
            continue
        
        for a in range(6):
            if (msk1 >> a) & 1:
                for b in range(6):
                    if a == b:
                        continue
                    if (msk2 >> b) & 1:
                        for c in range(6):
                            if a == c or b == c:
                                continue
                            if (msk3 >> c) & 1:
                                nmsk = (1 << a) | (1 << b) | (1 << c)
                                mask |= 1 << id_map[nmsk]
        
        X[mask] = add(X[mask], pp, mod)
    
    # Second part for Y
    for i in range(1 << 18):
        msk1 = i & A
        msk2 = (i >> 6) & A
        msk3 = (i >> 12) & A
        
        mask = 0
        pp = 1
        
        for j in range(6):
            if (msk1 >> j) & 1:
                pp = pp * p[3][j] % mod
            else:
                pp = pp * (mod + 1 - p[3][j]) % mod
        
        for j in range(6):
            if (msk2 >> j) & 1:
                pp = pp * p[4][j] % mod
            else:
                pp = pp * (mod + 1 - p[4][j]) % mod
        
        for j in range(6):
            if (msk3 >> j) & 1:
                pp = pp * p[5][j] % mod
            else:
                pp = pp * (mod + 1 - p[5][j]) % mod
        
        if pp == 0:
            continue
        
        for a in range(6):
            if (msk1 >> a) & 1:
                for b in range(6):
                    if a == b:
                        continue
                    if (msk2 >> b) & 1:
                        for c in range(6):
                            if a == c or b == c:
                                continue
                            if (msk3 >> c) & 1:
                                nmsk = (1 << a) | (1 << b) | (1 << c)
                                nmsk ^= A
                                mask |= 1 << id_map[nmsk]
        
        Y[mask] = add(Y[mask], pp, mod)
    
    # FWT on X and Y
    FWT(X, 1, mod)
    FWT(Y, 1, mod)
    
    # Point-wise multiplication
    for i in range(1048576):
        X[i] = X[i] * Y[i] % mod
    
    # Inverse FWT
    FWT(X, -1, mod)
    
    ans = 0
    for i in range(1, 1048576):
        ans = add(ans, X[i], mod)
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
